doc: A real-time program (game, emulator, demo) driven frame by frame by an Eden host.

constants.name: STEP_FRAME
constants.doc: eden_step: a frame was presented during this step

constants.name: STEP_QUIT
constants.doc: eden_step: the guest wants to stop

constants.name: STEP_ERROR
constants.doc: eden_step: the guest failed and logged why

exports.name: eden_abi_version
exports.doc: The world version the guest was built for.

exports.name: eden_alloc
exports.doc: Allocates size bytes in linear memory; 0 on failure.

exports.name: eden_free
exports.doc: Frees a pointer from eden_alloc; 0 is ignored.

exports.name: eden_init
exports.doc: Prepares the guest; 0 = ready, other values are the guest's error codes.

exports.name: eden_step
exports.doc: Works for about budget_us microseconds of host time; returns STEP_* flags.

exports.name: eden_shutdown
exports.doc: Releases everything; the instance is destroyed after it.

exports.name: eden_state_save
exports.doc: Writes the snapshot to guest memory [dst, dst + cap); returns bytes written or a negative error.

exports.name: eden_state_load
exports.doc: Restores a snapshot made by eden_state_save of the same guest build; 0 = ok.
